meta: Remove strangers or change the background of phone photos with AI: a stranger or a power pole in your photo is gone in a few seconds.

muc.title: Removing things from a photo
muc.text: A great photo with a stranger or a power pole behind you? The AI eraser on your phone fixes it in seconds.

muc.title: Circle it and erase
muc.text: Open the editor, pick the erase tool, circle what you want gone, and AI redraws the background.

muc.title: Change the background
muc.text: To change the background, cut out the subject and swap in a plain color or another scene. Check the edges of hair and fingers.

muc.title: Product photos must be real
muc.text: For product photos, only tidy the background. Don't erase scratches or change colors: customers who get something different lose trust.

muc.title: Zoom in to check
muc.text: Send a chatbot a photo with something unwanted, ask it to remove it, then zoom in to see if the filled area looks natural.

thu: Send a chatbot a photo with something unwanted, ask it to remove it, then zoom in to see if the filled area looks natural.
